hook.text: In 2018, Wisconsin Republicans won 63% of legislative seats with only 45% of the total vote. How?

buildup.text: Gerrymandering draws district boundaries to concentrate opponents into few districts and spread allies across many.

discovery.text: Two techniques: 'packing' opponents into overwhelming wins and 'cracking' them into narrow losses everywhere else.

twist.text: Both parties gerrymander when they control redistricting. It's a game where the rules-maker wins the game.

climax.text: Independent commissions and algorithmic redistricting aim to remove human bias from boundary drawing.

punchline.text: Who draws the map wins the election.

quiz.question: What is 'packing' in gerrymandering?
options: Concentrating opponents into a few districts they win overwhelmingly
